en:
Shuichi...doesn't this summons give you
an uneasy feeling?

Based on prior events...perhaps another <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>
is going to be announced?

The timing is similar to when we received
the Monokub Pads.
Yes, I think that may be the case.

But it's alright! No matter what kind of motive
is prepared for us...

Don't worry. We won't allow the killing game
to continue!

<CLT=cltMIND>That was strange...
Keebo is uncharacteristically optimistic.

<CLT=cltMIND>What did he mean by
"won't allow" it to continue?

<CLT=cltMIND>There is a boys bathroom...
No need for me to go into the girls bathroom.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
